author: The Infographics Show
description:
Everything looks amazing online, 4.5 stars, glowing reviews, perfect photos, and yet so much of it still ends up being terrible.

Why does everything have 4.5 stars but sucks dives into the broken rating systems behind modern life. From fake Amazon reviews and ghost kitchens on delivery apps to inflated Airbnb scores, bot-driven social media, and AI-generated junk flooding the internet, the numbers that were supposed to help you make better choices are now being manipulated at every level.

The result is a world where trust is collapsing, mediocrity is rewarded, and you’re forced to become your own full-time investigator just to avoid getting scammed.

So how did ratings become meaningless, and what happens when nobody trusts the stars anymore?

Narrated by: Josh Risser
